description: Acceptance checks for any asset featuring Ahmed El Sanhoury (me). Machine checks run first via scripts/eval_runner.py (deterministic, regex and string based). LLM checks run second (judged by the reviewing agent). Any failed hard check is a hard stop returning to the author with the failing item and required fix. Then english-copy-qa (or arabic-copy-qa when Arabic is in scope), then brand-qa-reviewer, then the human gate. Checks marked applies_to=assets run only on generated marketing assets; governance docs (the fact file, the held-back ledger) are checked with --docs.

machine_checks.fix: Replace em dash with comma, colon, or period
Replace en dash with 'to' or a hyphen in ranges
Never imply a credential or accreditation you do not hold; state only verified qualifications
Remove tatweel/kashida (only relevant when Arabic is in scope)
Use Western numerals (only relevant when Arabic is in scope)

_held_back_claim_blocks: Add one machine_check per row in the held-back ledger of context/subjects/me.md, severity hard, applies_to assets, that blocks the exact unverified or under-NDA phrasing. /mine-subject me generates these from the ledger.

llm_checks.rule: If the asset is public-facing, the catalog status for me must be 'public'. Until you confirm, status is 'internal': public assets are blocked, drafts carry a 'blocked on status' flag.

Every factual claim about Ahmed (title, role, result, figure, affiliation) maps to a claims-table row in context/subjects/me.md marked 'verified' and stays within what the source supports. No overstatement.
No client, employer, or collaborator is named publicly without recorded consent. No confidential or under-NDA work appears.
Titles, dates, numbers, and project outcomes appear only as recorded in the fact file or the brief. Missing means to-confirm, not to-invent.
Tone matches voice.md once mined: your register, hooks, and signature phrasing; not corporate, preachy, or hype.
